data.name: Nereid Fascination
data.description: Some undines can trace their ancestry to nereids as well as to outsiders. Once per day as a standard action, such an undine can create a 20-foot-radius aura that causes humanoids within the aura's range to become fascinated with her for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 the undine's character level (minimum 1). Targets may resist with a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 the undine's level + the undine's Charisma modifier).&nl;(fascinate rounds, DC ) This is a supernatural ability. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability racial trait.
